title: ERP P1 read-only acceptance matrix and local smoke guard

riskLevels.read_only: Only reads local fixture/code or authorized ERP data. No external mutation.
riskLevels.requires_authorization: Requires an authenticated ERP session and store-scoped permission before meaningful acceptance.
riskLevels.external_write_impact: Can mutate Ozon Seller, AI provider billing/jobs, plugin release flow, inventory, orders, or durable ERP business data.

globalGuards: Every module must validate a business workflow beyond route/page registration.
Every store-scoped request must carry a current store id or prove server-side user/store ownership filtering.
External write impact modules require an explicit operator confirmation, visible error result, and no real execution in local smoke.
Unavailable analytics, ranking, AI, Ozon Seller, or plugin data sources must degrade visibly instead of blanking the page.
Single sourcing v2 must be restored as an independent collection-workflow entry, not as a selection-center tab.

readonlyAcceptance: List shops from the authenticated user's store scope.
Mask Client ID in the table and never render API keys.
Display manifest, zip, and installed plugin versions with a refresh action.
authorizationAcceptance: Adding, removing, or editing store settings requires an authenticated session.
Watermark and plugin settings refresh visible store state after save.

bugsOrGaps.summary: v1 store routes from the team contract are not the primary UI path yet; keep compatibility plan tracked before external test acceptance.

readonlyAcceptance: Tabs cover visible, ready, attention, moderation, inactive, and all statuses.
Search, pagination, CSV export, procurement URL, image preview, and compliance issues are visible.
Filtered export must use the same store/search/status scope as the table.
authorizationAcceptance: Field edits verify user_id, store_id, and offer_id ownership server-side.
Bulk archive is capped at 100 selected items and reports downstream sync results.
externalWriteAcceptance: Price/image sync to Ozon is not part of local smoke and must be accepted only in an authorized test store.

readonlyAcceptance: List collection items by status, current store, search term, and pagination.
Show failed reasons, ignored state, source URL, all images, cost, suggested price, and profit risk color.
CSV export includes SKU, source URL, images, status, and failure note.
authorizationAcceptance: Import, edit, retry, ignore, restore, and bulk delete mutate only the authorized user's store data.
Repeated links/SKUs are skipped or merged instead of duplicating work.
externalWriteAcceptance: Collector execution is not part of local smoke; live collector/Ozon page scraping needs explicit operator authorization.

bugsOrGaps.summary: Local fixture and structure guard now cover duplicate URL/SKU parse, merge, and skip behavior; authorized collector-chain testing is still required.

readonlyAcceptance: Single sourcing is an independent menu entry and route, not a tab inside the selection center.
Task logs show timestamp, severity, source row, total progress, and the current Ozon/1688/AI stage.
Results and Excel history expose Ozon image, 1688 candidates, MOQ, freight, weight, AI decision, confidence, and failure reason.
authorizationAcceptance: The ERP page grants the extension a short-lived worker token; the extension does not ask for or store an ERP username/password.
Queued jobs are scoped to the current user and store so only the current online worker can claim them.
1688 login or captcha is surfaced as an operator-visible status instead of a silent generic failure.
externalWriteAcceptance: Local smoke must not scrape Ozon/1688 or call AI providers; live 9/20-row tests require explicit operator authorization.
Single sourcing must not touch BatchUpload import payload, rich content, stock, warehouse, watermark, or import-by-sku flow.

bugsOrGaps.summary: Static guards only prove the single-sourcing contract is wired. Real 1688 login/captcha behavior, AI review, and Excel image/freight/weight completeness still need authorized test-environment evidence.

readonlyAcceptance: Paste parsing shows item validity, category resolution confidence, multi-image payload, rich content, stock, warehouse, and per-store readiness before publish.
Plugin freshness is checked before collection; publish prefers Seller Portal silent bundle upload and falls back to official import-by-sku when the portal channel fails.
Completion copy distinguishes Ozon task submitted/processing from final success.
authorizationAcceptance: Publishing requires an authenticated ERP page and current store selection.
Multi-store publish isolates warehouse ids and ignores stale warehouse config that does not belong to the target store.
externalWriteAcceptance: Real publish calls Ozon Seller import-by-sku or V3 import, is not part of local smoke, and must only run in an authorized test store.
Acceptance must preserve multi-image gallery, title, category/type_id, attributes, rich content JSON, stock, warehouse, and price.
Slow Ozon task creation is tracked as processing and never prematurely failed.
